ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible surface is dominated by low-intensity pixels (black) with high-intensity (white) focal points comprising approximately 15% of the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity pigmentation across both lobes. High-contrast white geometric blobs are densely mapped to the medial-inferior region of the left lobe and the inferior margin of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The distal margin of the left lobe displays high-amplitude, high-frequency serrations (pixel peaks); the right lobe trailing edge displays a more continuous, low-amplitude irregular linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory along the trailing margins of both lobes, terminating in acute, slightly upward-curved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel groups (rosettes) are localized on the mid-to-lower left lobe and the distal right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions on the medial section of the right lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular jaggedness and physical variation on the far left terminal edge of the fluke, inconsistent with natural taper.
